title: From Prompts to Reflection: Designing Reflective Play for GenAI Literacy

bias_targets.methodology: Using highly concise, underspecified text-to-image prompts during a multiplayer game to surface the model's default racial and ethnic representations (e.g., observing that the prompt 'A man' defaults to generating a white man).

Testing short, underspecified prompts to reveal historical gender roles, age stereotypes, or biological assumptions in model defaults (e.g., prompting 'CEO' to see if it yields a middle-aged white male, or 'Holding baby' yielding a woman).

Evaluating text-to-image outputs from ambiguous or broad prompts (e.g., 'A birthday party' or 'An exotic building') to identify Western-centric defaults and cultural stereotypes in the generated images.
